  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"synthetic_identity",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"Address linkage and failed identity/payment verification are consistent with a misrepresented identity. The packet does not identify which verification component failed, so this mechanism remains unconfirmed."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"household",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"A shared home address plausibly explains the linked accounts, and earlier repayment supports ordinary customer activity. However, the address does not qualify for the household exception, and the failed check materially weakens the benign explanation."
    }
  ],
  "disposition":"escalate",
  "citations":["FP-2 §5.3(b)","FP-2 §6.6(b)","R08","FP-2 §6.4(b)","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.5(f)"],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R08 holds and Linkage is the only adverse family; no Context rule holds. The home-address household exception does not apply because the registered address is too recent. No earlier outcome settles the order. Although shared household use and full repayment offer a benign explanation, repayment does not establish who ordered. The failed id_check decides the case under §5.3(b), making escalation standard with Linkage present; decline is also permitted. Recommend escalate. The order is unshipped, so the recommended action can prevent fulfilment. No further check is needed, and the failure does not establish a specific fraud mechanism."
